questions.question: In the Garden of Eden, what did the serpent tell the woman would happen if she ate the forbidden fruit?

answers.text: God will not mind at all

questions.question: After the serpent spoke to the first woman, what did she do with the fruit of the forbidden tree?

answers.text: She took the fruit and ate it
She walked away from the tree
She asked the serpent to leave

questions.question: When the LORD God asked the first woman what she had done, who did she say deceived her?
God told the serpent there would be enmity between its seed and the first woman's seed. Who will crush whose head?

answers.text: Her seed will crush the serpent's head
The serpent will crush her seed's head
The serpent's seed will crush her head
